description: Free, no payment. Finds the Internet Archive (Wayback Machine) snapshot of a URL closest to an optional date: whether one exists, its link and capture time. Next step (paid): Need proof of what a page says right now? Page Proof captures it and signs it with the time.

date.description: Optional: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Without it, the most recent copy.

name: web_archive_lookup
title: Web Archive Lookup: Closest saved copy of a page
